children: Arrowhead reported plozasiran reduced acute pancreatitis event rates by 78% versus placebo overall and 91% among patients with prior pancreatitis within five years. A separate interim ARO-DIMER-PA analysis showed LDL-C reductions of 26%–65% and median triglyceride reductions of 56%–78% from baseline; results were not placebo-adjusted.

Plozasiran cut pancreatitis event rate 78% vs placebo
The pooled SHASTA-3/4 result is a clinically meaningful efficacy signal; the release gives no prior-period comparison.
Prior pancreatitis subgroup rate fell 91% vs placebo
The larger reduction in a high-risk subgroup may strengthen the candidate’s clinical case; this is a subgroup result.
No AP events in 35 treated patients with TG ≥880 mg/dL
The comparison was five events among 17 placebo patients, but the subgroup is small.
PALISADE: TGs down 76% through up to 36 months
Long-term durability is a positive signal, but extension findings are descriptive and lacked a concurrent placebo control.
ARO-DIMER-PA LDL-C down 26%–65% from baseline
Interim single-dose results support activity across lipid pathways, but cohorts and follow-up varied and effects were not placebo-adjusted.
ARO-DIMER-PA median TGs down 56%–78% from baseline
The reductions support further development, while longer-term durability, optimal dosing, and cardiovascular benefit remain unestablished.
